title: where an approval's seconds go: launch P3's records and a local stub run

findings.claim: At least about 53 s of each 71 s P3 approval on one stream is in steps the compile does not share (audit records, repository write, tag and promotion, the orchestrator's part); the compiler's own steps take 4.45 s on a local stub run, and no record names the step on the box

An approval with nothing edited or rejected translates its CQL again (3 cold JVM runs, 4.3 s of 4.45 s locally) and loads FHIRHelpers and TB_Common (1.54 MB) to the FHIR server again, both unchanged since the compile
refresh_installed reads, hashes and parses every installed table again on each compile and approval, about 30 us per row (3.1 s at 100,000 rows)
